name: project-dotcor
description: A general project diagnostic plugin for Codex workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose any local project and suggest the next commands.
interface.longDescription: Project Dotcor helps Codex inspect a workspace, identify the project type, find common setup files, and suggest practical commands to run, test, build, or repair the project.
defaultPrompt: Use Project Dotcor to diagnose this project.
Find how to run, test, and build this workspace.
Check this folder for common project setup problems.
